content.introduction: The sources provide details on economic calendars from TradingView, Trading Economics, and IG. TradingView's Economic Calendar lists upcoming economic events affecting assets, regions, and markets, with customizable options and expert forecasts. Trading Economics' calendar offers comprehensive data releases for 196 countries, including actual values, consensus figures, and forecasts for 300,000 economic indicators. IG's calendar allows browsing and searching for macroeconomic events, earnings announcements, IPOs, and stock splits. Specific events on Trading Economics for October 2, 2026, include Private House Approvals MoM Final AUG in Australia, 30-Year KTB Auction in South Korea, Foreign Exchange Reserves SEP in Indonesia, BoJ JGB Purchase in Japan, and RBI Interest Rate Decision in India.

# Calendar

## How to use Economic Calendar

Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. [...] All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade.

Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center.
